certificate.argument: The rectangle is inside its orientation-invariant circle. During turn/wait centres are fixed. During translation relative centres equal a+q*b for one shared q in [0,1]; the convex quadratic minimum and candidate axis-aligned segment/closed-obstacle distances are checked exactly; all other obstacles are excluded by a conservative axis-distance lower bound. Endpoints cover all barriers and permanent terminal holds.
conditions: Exact ideal tracking of these reference primitives; zero error only.
Moving robots share one physical progress value and every barrier start; no independent time shifts.
No continuous safety claim for different speed/turn/clock conditions or an actual feedback controller.
Printed float times/progress samples represent analytic profiles; they are not a verified floating-point controller.
certificate.obstacle_broadphase: Inclusive grid box expanded by (body_length+body_width+cell)/2; exact candidate distance checks; excluded closed cells separated by an axis lower bound.
